_comment.model: agy display label, e.g. 'Gemini 3.5 Flash (High)'. Written to per-agent agents/<agent_id>/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json (merged with real HOME base). Empty/missing → inherits model from real HOME settings. If real HOME also has no model, agy uses its built-in default.
_comment.compile-startup-md: If true, compile IDENTITY.md + INSTRUCTION.md + MEMORY.md into cwd/AGENTS.md
_comment.fallback: If true, route to fallback_backend when agy quota usage >= usage_threshold
_comment.fallback_backend: Backend to fall back to: pi, cc, kimi, or openclaw. Quota-aware backends (gemini/agy) are excluded to prevent transitive fallback chains
_comment.usage_threshold: Usage percentage (0-100) at which to trigger fallback (default: 95)
